_doc: War-bands (Dungeon Alive slice 5, C1; src/war_bands.py): groups that act like a unit, with roles from their lore. A band makes camp in one room of a floor (it replaces that room's ordinary roll), from 'floors' [first, last]. 'chance' is the share of floors in range that hold a band (at most one band a floor). Roles: 'leader' (one; while he lives his followers do not lose their nerve, and when one of the band spots the hero the whole band is roused), 'guard' (keep beside the leader), 'shooter' (keeps its distance), 'caster', 'healer' (mends the band). Each role lists kinds; only kinds the floor's own spawn pool allows are used, so a band is never out of its depth (LORE, NOT FLOOR). 'counts' [min, max] per role. 'morale' is what the band does when its leader falls: 'rout' (they flee), 'crumble' (the dead he raised fall where they stand), 'quarrel' (they turn on one another). 'camp' lists the fixtures of its camp. 'line' is said on arrival; 'known_line' instead when the hero knows the leader's family (studied, or its family tier): it names the band's make-up, {roster}. 'rout_line' is said when the leader falls, 'break_line' when a great blow on the leader breaks their nerve.

goblin_raiders.name: a goblin war-band
goblin_raiders.line: Somewhere on this floor, drums, and a lot of feet. Goblins have made camp.
goblin_raiders.known_line: Drums, and goblin war-cries: a war-band has made camp on this floor. {roster}. Kill the chief, and the rest lose their nerve.
goblin_raiders.rout_line: With their chief down, the goblins lose their nerve and scatter!
goblin_raiders.break_line: The goblins see their chief take that blow, and waver.

gnoll_pack.name: a gnoll pack
gnoll_pack.line: High, cackling laughter echoes off the stone. Something hunts here in a pack.
gnoll_pack.known_line: That cackling is gnolls, hunting as a pack. {roster}. Their courage is their pack lord's.
gnoll_pack.rout_line: The pack lord falls, and the gnolls yelp and bolt!
gnoll_pack.break_line: The gnolls flinch as their pack lord staggers.

bandit_crew.name: a bandit crew
bandit_crew.line: Woodsmoke, and laughter that stops when you stop walking. Somebody has a camp down here.
bandit_crew.known_line: Bandits have made camp on this floor. {roster}. They fight for their captain's coin, and run when he can't pay.
bandit_crew.rout_line: With their captain down, the crew decides this was never worth it!
bandit_crew.break_line: The bandits glance at each other as their captain reels.

cult_circle.name: a cult circle
cult_circle.line: Chanting, low and far off, the same five words over and over.
cult_circle.known_line: A cult is chanting somewhere on this floor. {roster}. Their faith is in their priest; take him and see how long it lasts.
cult_circle.rout_line: Their priest falls, and the faithful remember they have somewhere else to be!
cult_circle.break_line: The chanting falters as their priest staggers.

necro_procession.name: a necromancer and his dead
necro_procession.line: Bones click somewhere, all together, like soldiers marching.
necro_procession.known_line: A necromancer walks this floor with his dead. {roster}. The dead he raised are bound to him: end him, and they fall.
necro_procession.rout_line: Their master falls, and the dead he raised fall with him!
necro_procession.break_line: The bound dead stagger as their master reels.

giant_hunt.name: a giant and his hounds
giant_hunt.line: Baying, and under it something huge, sniffing the air.
giant_hunt.known_line: A giant hunts this floor with his hounds. {roster}. The hounds follow him; without him they lose interest.
giant_hunt.rout_line: Their master falls, and the hounds lose interest in you!
giant_hunt.break_line: The hounds whine as their master staggers.

fae_hunt.name: a hunt of the Fair Folk
fae_hunt.line: A horn sounds, very far away, and it is the loneliest sound you have ever heard.
fae_hunt.known_line: The Fair Folk are riding a hunt on this floor. {roster}. They follow their leader for the sport of it; take that away and they will find other sport.
fae_hunt.rout_line: Their leader falls, and the Fair Folk melt back into the shadows!
fae_hunt.break_line: The hunt hesitates as its leader reels.

demon_warband.name: a warband of devils
demon_warband.line: Iron rings on iron somewhere, and a voice giving orders in no language you know.
demon_warband.known_line: Devils march on this floor under a captain. {roster}. They obey him out of fear; without him, they turn on each other.
demon_warband.rout_line: Their captain falls, and the devils turn on one another!
demon_warband.break_line: The devils snarl at one another as their captain reels.
